top_violation_types.title: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional (26 TAC §746.2421(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The infants did not have infant feeding instructions available for review.

top_violation_types.title: AP Additional Caregiver Responsibilities - Number of Unrelated Children Never Exceeds 3 (26 TAC §742.307(3)(A))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Caregiver had 9 unrelated children in her care on a regular basis for compensation.

top_violation_types.title: Prohibited Punishments - Using Harsh, Abusive or Profane Language (26 TAC §742.603(b)(6))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Based off of a DFPS investigation, on 02/19/24 the caregiver and a home member are heard on a recording telling children to "shut up."

top_violation_types.title: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity (26 TAC §747.501(8))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operational policy did not include the information of indoor and outdoor physical activity.

top_violation_types.title: First Aid Kit - Complete Kit (26 TAC §747.3803(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: First aid kit reviewed was missing guide to first aid.

top_violation_types.title: Children's Products- Annual Certification (26 TAC §747.3935(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The permit holder has not completed the annual certification.

top_violation_types.title: Required Immunizations Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current (26 TAC §747.613(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The immunization record for one child was not up to date.

top_violation_types.title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §747.603(a)(3))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One child is missing a health statement.
